text: {"assertions":["An intermittent EOF issue during TLS handshake negotiation was fixed in crypto/tls/handshake.go on 2026-04-04.","The EOF issue specifically affected clients that were pinned to the v1 SDK.","The problem was reproducible by opening many short-lived connections in rapid succession.","The root cause of the intermittent EOF was clock skew between the two communicating hosts.","The fix involved switching from a wall clock to a monotonic clock for the handshake deadline (PR #2202 on branch fix/intermittent-eof-1).","A related flaky test improved from 57 failures per 100 runs to zero failures after applying the fix."]}
